temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa seems overburdened during the community service project. When Arthur offers help, she initially says she can manage, but then accepts his help with organizing medical supplies.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: No specific prior belief about Teresa being overburdened; he did not yet see her as needing assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He forms the belief that Teresa is overburdened and needs help, and that she is receptive when assistance is offered persistently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa needs help and would benefit from assistance; Arthur is concerned for her well-being.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer assistance and help Teresa with her tasks.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa admits she wants to show she can do things by herself, but she listens to Arthur and agrees that teamwork can be effective and that accepting help does not mean she is incapable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa is hesitant to accept help because she wants to prove her capability.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, his belief is confirmed and adjusted: Teresa values self-reliance, but she can accept reassurance that teamwork does not undermine her ability.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa wants to prove herself, but she can accept help and collaborative work without feeling inadequate.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Teresa and encourage a supportive, teamwork-based approach.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa still seems to be struggling and says she feels like she is falling behind, despite Arthur's earlier reassurance. She agrees to try working together as a team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Arthur hoped his reassurance and offer of help would be enough to ease Teresa's burden.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He now believes his previous approach has not sufficiently helped and that a different, collaborative approach is needed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa is still struggling; working together may support her better without making her feel inadequate.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Find another way to support Teresa and propose a shared, collaborative approach.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees that the collaborative approach already feels less overwhelming. They agree that Arthur will handle inventory while Teresa manages patient records, and they will check in regularly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Working together may ease Teresa's burden and improve their efficiency.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, confirmed and strengthened. Teresa's agreement and relief increase Arthur's hope that collaboration is effective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The collaborative approach is easing Teresa's burden and improving efficiency; fully committing to it is worthwhile.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Fully commit to the collaborative approach, keep momentum, and check in regularly.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees their teamwork paid off, says it has been a great experience, supports continuing the collaborative approach in future projects, and thanks Arthur for being supportive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Their collaboration has been effective and productive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, confirmed and strengthened. The collaboration is not only effective but has also strengthened their professional relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teamwork strengthens their professional relationship and should be maintained in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain and continue the collaborative approach in future projects.
